drops.text: The latest wave dropped items shaped like earlier waste. Same dents. Same stamps.

walk_in.text: A new inmate walked in at dawn. It has your sentence number. It has your handwriting.

hum.text: It hums an old inmate's name. We are all just ledger entries with legs.

nest.text: In a nest: a survey crew tag, still warm. The creatures wear what they have eaten.

feed.label: Feed them (dump waste at the Penance Beacon)
feed.text: They eat. The hum stops for two days.

cleanse.label: Cleanse (40 plates)
cleanse.text: The tags burn. The planet breathes out.

study.label: Study the tag
study.text: Survey crew, tag 7. Last seen: here. Specimen secured.
study.hint: Unlocks the survey tag clue. Creatures drop double essence for 2 days. One mimic specimen escapes.
